title: Offence: protected wild plants
rule: Without lawful authority or excuse (burden on the accused), picking, damaging or destroying a listed wild plant, or possessing, selling, buying or exporting one, is an offence.
points: Covers the same acts banned by s.67(4), plus exposing for sale, possessing with intent to sell, and exporting or attempting to export a listed plant.
checks: Plant is on a gazetted list
penalty: Fine of TSh 200,000 to 1,000,000, or imprisonment for 6 months to 2 years, or both (s.86).
